title: Human-centered bilingual mission
expected: Both homepages explain people and genes/brain/behavior/environment, rather than model names alone.

title: Four question-led entry points
expected: Homepage exposes four distinct question links to detailed research.

title: Question to method explanation
expected: Research overview visibly explains at least one data/design choice for each research direction.

title: Demonstrated examples have research sources
expected: Research page shows concrete study examples and external publication references.

title: Limits remain visible beside research
expected: Research explanation includes predictive/causal boundary and unvalidated next-step language.

title: No-JavaScript research meaning
expected: Disabling scripts preserves all four questions and substantial explanatory research text.

title: Homepage layer links to detail
expected: Each unique homepage research question link reaches its corresponding visible explanatory section.

title: No unsupported superlative promise
expected: Homepage does not promise guaranteed admission, guaranteed results or world-best ranking as fact.

title: Research locale coverage parity
expected: Both locales expose the same four research directions through corresponding anchors.

title: Narrow-screen explanation readability
expected: Research prose at 320px is visible, has no replacement characters or clipped horizontal extent.

title: Homepage research figure loads
expected: Each homepage includes a rendered informative research image.

title: Figure caption carries scientific meaning
expected: Homepage research caption explains the represented observation and its interpretation boundary.

title: Figure credit is a traceable link
expected: A visible source link is associated with the homepage research figure.

title: Research surface labeled as reference
expected: The research illustration is identified as a reference surface with a source, not a result localization map.

title: Informative image alternatives
expected: Every rendered research/homepage image has an alt attribute; figure images have nonempty alternatives.

title: Narrow figure and caption containment
expected: Figures and their captions stay inside the 320px viewport.

title: Figure source works without scripts
expected: Caption, credit link and decoded figure remain available when JavaScript is disabled.

title: Missing image retains explanation
expected: When image responses fail, textual figure alternative and visible caption still explain the content.

title: Image provenance locale parity
expected: Both locales use the same homepage research figure source and credit destination.

title: Image license stays visible
expected: Research figure attribution states the license in both languages.

title: Homepage offers application path
expected: A reader can click a visible homepage action and reach the locale-appropriate join page.

title: Application route names supported roles
expected: Join page identifies graduate, postdoctoral and undergraduate/intern routes without inventing openings.

title: Concrete application materials
expected: Applicants see CV, transcript and a research-interest statement requirement.

title: Public contact action
expected: Join includes a syntactically valid usable mailto application contact.

title: Research culture gives concrete expectations
expected: Join explains independence, learning, collaboration and research completion.

title: Openings uncertainty preserved
expected: Join asks readers to verify current openings and distinguishes formal university admission.

title: Keyboard-operable FAQ
expected: FAQ question can be focused and expanded with Enter, revealing its answer.

title: Application without JavaScript
expected: No-JS visitors can reach application instructions and contact.

title: Application locale contact parity
expected: Both languages direct applications to the same verified public mailbox and matching program families.

title: Mobile application anchor
expected: At 390px the join page application anchor reaches visible preparation/contact instructions.

title: Responsive home layout
expected: Both homepages fit 320/390/1440px without horizontal overflow.

title: Responsive research layout
expected: Both research pages fit 320/390/1440px without horizontal overflow.

title: Responsive join layout
expected: Both join pages fit 320/390/1440px without horizontal overflow.

title: Reading landmarks and heading
expected: Core pages provide one visible h1, main landmark and named document language.

title: Controls have accessible names
expected: All visible core-page interactive controls have usable names.

title: Keyboard mobile menu
expected: A keyboard user opens mobile navigation and follows Research.

title: Keyboard focus remains perceptible
expected: Focused primary application link has visible outline or box-shadow focus styling.

title: Native research navigation without scripts
expected: At 320px all four native research links remain usable with JavaScript disabled.

title: Text enlargement does not clip content
expected: Core pages at 200% root text sizing remain readable without horizontal overflow.

title: Reduced motion preserves content
expected: Reduced-motion readers retain headline, research links, figures and application action.

title: Public route preservation
expected: All eight established public routes load in both languages.

title: Locale switch preserves route
expected: Core pages offer the counterpart locale and follow it without losing page intent.

title: Core internal destinations resolve
expected: Every visible core-page local link has a successful response; fragment IDs exist.

title: Core assets decode
expected: All main images on home, research and join decode successfully.

title: Page metadata describes each route
expected: Each core locale page has distinct title and nonempty description plus HTTPS canonical.

title: Legacy Korean redirects
expected: Established /ko and /ko/research links reach Korean content.

title: Graceful unknown route
expected: Unknown URL returns a genuine 404 with a visible explanation, not a blank page or false-success homepage.

title: Publication no-match and recovery
expected: Impossible publication search explains zero results; clearing restores publications.

title: Runtime console remains error-free
expected: Core-page loads and native disclosures cause no browser page errors.

title: Deep-link reload preserves target
expected: A research link can be bookmarked and reloaded, retaining a valid visible section.

title: Dated public review artifact
expected: Request-scoped public review exists and explicitly records the 2026-10-20 revision.

title: Concrete before-after examples
expected: Public review includes concrete before/after text and the rationale for changes.

title: Claim-source mapping
expected: Public review maps claims to identifiable source URLs and section/figure/table locators.

title: Image provenance record
expected: Image record identifies source and license plus excerpt/transformation provenance.

title: Scope and remaining verification
expected: Public review distinguishes executed work from unresolved verification and PI decisions.

title: Public artifact local links resolve
expected: All local Markdown link targets in the request-specific review exist.

title: Public documentation contains no private operational paths
expected: Review does not expose home-directory paths, credentials, private workspace links or secret-bearing strings.

title: Verification is reproducible
expected: Public review records actual build/browser verification commands or links to their report, and distinguishes science review.

title: Maintenance and future updates documented
expected: Public review states how reviewed content and sources should be updated or revalidated.

title: New review is indexed by canonical content review
expected: Canonical content review mentions this dated revision or links its public report.

title: Question-to-evidence reading path
expected: A homepage reader follows a research figure/context link and finds question, representative study and limits.

title: Research interest becomes application
expected: After reading a research question visitors can reach locale-correct application information from navigation.

title: Mobile visual explanation
expected: At 390px decoded research figure, explanatory caption and credit remain readable together.

title: Keyboard mobile applicant flow
expected: At 320px applicant follows visible CTA by Enter then opens a FAQ and can reach contact.

title: Mobile locale round trip
expected: At 390px language switching twice preserves research route and no overflow.

title: Visible figure ties to provenance record
expected: The homepage credit source is explicitly traceable in public image/review documentation.

title: Korean mobile prospective graduate
expected: 390px Korean visitor reads mission, research detail, application preparation and contact.

title: English desktop researcher
expected: 1440px English reader reviews image credit, follows research evidence, then finds publications and application.

title: Low-script narrow-screen applicant
expected: 320px visitor with scripts disabled can read question, its evidence, and prepare an application.

title: Bilingual reader compares meaning boundaries
expected: Reader switches homepage language, sees same figure/source and matching scope dimensions, then follows research.

title: Skeptical visitor recovers from no-match search
expected: Publication visitor sees empty-state feedback, clears it, finds evidence, and returns to research navigation.

title: Question links remain keyboard readable
expected: At 320px keyboard activation of a question reaches a visible explanatory heading without clipping.

title: Research breadth survives route reload and locale change
expected: All four question destinations still resolve after navigation and the paired locale retains all four.

title: Research examples tie to public claim record
expected: A named representative model in the rendered research explanation is present in the public claim/source review.

title: Figure reading does not dead-end applicant
expected: After viewing homepage evidence and source credit, an applicant can reach instructions without leaving the locale.

title: Figure assets survive language navigation
expected: A decoded figure and its provenance remain available after switching locale and reloading.

title: Application route reload and locale equivalence
expected: A bookmarked application page retains preparation and same contact after locale change and reload.

title: Applicant edits have a durable scope record
expected: Working public application path is accompanied by a public review of recruitment/application changes and remaining approval boundaries.

title: Responsive evidence records actual target widths
expected: Public review records the 320/390/1440 browser conditions whose homepage behavior is reproducible.

title: Reproducible verification points to current public route contract
expected: Documented verification references coexist with reachable locale core routes and the canonical record indexes the same revision.
